notes.title: Version 1.3.0.0 - Major Update
notes.content:
We have made a major update to the game to fix many visual and non-visual bugs. We have also changed some information on the user interface as well as the game menu.
Find the patch notes on our website: Legends of Kailrate - Patch Notes

VERSION 1.3.0.0:


 Game Performance: Lumen and Nanite have been disabled.
 Lobby: The lobby has been redesigned.
 Optimization: Code optimization for smoother and faster data transmission.
 Internal Settings: Review of some internal parameters to improve performance.
 FPS Refresh Rate: Changed the FPS refresh rate from 0.2 seconds to 1 second.
 Scoreboard: Reduced the size of the scoreboard at the end of a match.
 Quest Display: Quest display is now limited to a maximum of 3.
 Hide Action Key Display: Added the "Hide Action Key Display" option to hide in-game controls.
 Security: Implemented a security feature: if a player goes above or through the map, they will be returned to the center of the map.
 FPS Stability: Fixed FPS instability that caused erroneous values; values will no longer exceed the maximum limit set in the settings.
 EXP Multiplier: Adjusted the EXP bar multiplier from 100x1.5 to 100x1.2, reducing from 50% to 20%.
 EXP Bar: The EXP bar is now fixed at 5000 EXP. Unlike before, it is now possible to surpass level 16 (+20% per level up to 5000, the multiplier is then removed when this value is reached).
 EXP Visibility: The EXP count is now displayed.
 Life Visibility: Life points are now displayed.
 Enemy Quests: Revision of EXP for enemy quests:



 Enemy Quests: Revision of EXP for enemy quests:
 Kill 15 Enemies: Changes from 1500 to 500 EXP.
 Kill 20 Enemies: Changes from 2500 to 700 EXP.
 Kill 30 Enemies: Changes from 3500 to 1200 EXP.
 New: Kill 50 Enemies > 1800 EXP.
 New: Kill 70 Enemies > 2500 EXP.
 Kill 100 Enemies: Changes from 6500 to 3200 EXP.



 Teleportation: Added player teleportation mobility.
 Menu Buttons: Revised buttons in the menu.
 Black Fade: Reduced the black fade in the lobby from 2 seconds to 1 second.
 Credits Bug: The credits bug that played the music several times with the space bar has been fixed.
 Bug Fix: Fixed a reoccurring issue in version 1.2.0.0 (spawn of enemies & bosses above the object at the center of the map with a 0.238% chance on 100).

notes.title: Version 1.2.0.0 - Major Update
notes.content:
More information on the website: Legends of Kailrate - Patch Notes

New Features:

 Complete Artistic Overhaul: A full revision of the visual style for a more immersive experience.
 Terrain Changes: Modifications to the terrain to enhance both aesthetics and gameplay.
 New Scenery Added: Enriched the environment with new visual elements.
 Particle Effects: Added particle effects for increased dynamism and realism.
 Minor Lighting Adjustments: Subtle lighting tweaks to improve the overall atmosphere.
 Event Alert: Added a notification to inform players when a boss is approaching.


Bug Fixes:

 Score Recording Fix: Resolved an issue where scores reaching 1,000 were not being recorded due to a comma in the queries.
 Graphics Adjustment: Optimized graphics for certain clients to resolve FPS drops and instability issues.

notes.title: Version 1.1.0.0 - Major Update
notes.content:
We are excited to present Version 1.1.0.0 of our game, a major update that enhances both performance and playability. Here are the key highlights of this release:

More information on the website: Legends of Kailrate - Patch Notes


 Keyboard Display: Fixed display issues for WASD/ZQSD keyboards.
 QWERTY Combination: Resolved an issue that prevented access to the pause menu on WASD keyboards.
 Optimization and FPS Display: Fixed FPS display issues and optimized in-game performance.
 Music Transition Management: Fixed a bug that caused a music change when exiting the game’s audio zone.
 User Interface Update: Enhanced the interface for a better user experience.
 Graphics Settings Optimization: Adjustments made to improve graphical quality and performance.
 Crash Resolution: Fixed crashes on low-performance PC configurations.
 Boss EXP Rebalancing: Adjusted boss experience from 1,000/25,000 EXP to 5,200/10,000 EXP.
 Spawn Bug Fix: Fixed an issue where a boss would spawn above an Unreal object in the center of the map (0.238% chance).
 Credits Stabilization: Eliminated audio bugs in the credits.
 Performance Improvement: Overall performance has been optimized, and FPS drops caused by enemy spawns have been corrected.
 Update Reminder: Added an update reminder system.
 Leaderboard: A leaderboard is now available online and in-game.
 Real-Time Game Stats: Track kills and game sessions in real-time with stats on kills versus games played.
